name: bench-press-band-incline
title: Bench Press: Band (Incline)
primer: This is an exercise for chest and triceps strengthening.
steps: Securely fasten the band under the leg of an incline bench, near your head.
Lie on the bench with your feet flat on the floor in order to stabilize your movements.
Grasp one end of the band in each hand and start with your hands at chest level.
Press upwards so your arms are fully extended.
With a slow controlled motion return to the starting position.
